name: BKF Capital Group, Inc.
summary: BKF Capital Group, Inc., operating through its subsidiaries, allocates capital to a diverse range of publicly traded and privately held businesses. Additionally, the firm offers specialized investment banking solutions, encompassing strategic merger and acquisition (M&A) advisory and capital-raising initiatives, primarily aimed at lower and middle-market enterprises. Established in 1954, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in Irvine, California.
